decisions.reason: The guided historic mill tour extends the firm's existing hospitality operations but is less directly tied to core baking knowledge, so the firm has only moderate absorptive capacity and a somewhat higher chance of dropping it.
The sweet pastry is close to the firm's traditional confectionery skills and recipes, allowing the firm to interpret early results and continue improving it.
The crusty farmhouse bread closely matches the firm's established bread-making knowledge, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and refine it.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen is a flagship product closely aligned with core recipes and has already received an award, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The premium Christmas stollen draws on existing confectionery expertise and has been recognized, so the firm can apply its knowledge well and is unlikely to drop it.
